_comment: NETRA thresholds. Every threshold used anywhere in the project lives here; never inline a number in code. Phase 2 added io.*, preproc.fov*, and degradation.*.

quality._comment: Phase 3. focusMin/contrastMin retained for the Phase 1 UI wiring; the eight *Min/*Max keys below are the per-feature gates. Track D calibrated focusLaplacianMin/focusTenengradMin against MEASURED features on a real APTOS grade-0 fundus (clean vs blur-0.9): clean Lap=0.042 Ten=1.52, blurred Lap=0.005 Ten=0.27. Thresholds set between those so severe blur trips the H4 hard-reject (both below) while a sharp image stays Good. Remaining values are still engineering estimates - refine against validation/results_quality.mat after train_quality.

preproc._comment: Track A (Phase 4). illumKernelFraction/benGrahamSigmaFraction are expressed as a fraction of the FOV radius so they are resolution-aware. uniformityTrigger/denoiseTrigger/contrastTarget are on the 0..1 green scale, matching quality.* subscores. claheClipMin/Max bound the CONTRAST-DERIVED clip limit; claheClipDefault/claheClipMax above are retained for the Phase 1-3 UI wiring.

lesions._comment: Track A (Phase 6). Area thresholds (maAreaMax/heAreaMin/exMinArea) are in px^2 AT THE 512px target size and are rescaled at runtime by (odRadius/referenceOdRadius512)^2 so they track disc scale, not raw pixels. referenceOdRadius512 is the nominal disc radius at 512px. seLength is the vessel-suppression structuring-element length (px at 512, also disc-scaled). PLACEHOLDER values are engineering estimates, NOT tuned on IDRiD (absent on disk) - tune via validation/eval_lesions.m.

grading._comment: Track B (Phase 7). referableThreshold/temperature are UNTUNED PLACEHOLDERS - no CNN was trained (no APTOS on disk, no MATLAB/GPU here), so the system runs Fallback Path C: rule-based grading via icdrRule, provenance RULE_BASED_NO_CNN. When path A/B is enabled, retune referableThreshold on VALIDATION for sensitivity>=0.90 and refit temperature on VALIDATION - do NOT report metrics at 0.5. classOrder is the fixed ICDR label order the (future) net head must match. disagreementLevels: rule vs CNN gap that raises grade.disagreement. useFusion off until Track A lesion features + a fitted fusion model exist.

xai._comment: Track B (Phase 8). alaHighThreshold/alaLowThreshold band the Attention-Lesion Agreement score. gradcamColormap is a named MATLAB colormap for the heatmap overlay. Under Path C no Grad-CAM is produced (no trained net); ALA is NaN and these are dormant until a net exists.

structures._comment: Track A (Phase 5). frangiScales are vessel radii in px at the 512px target (multi-scale). vesselThreshold is on the normalised 0..1 vesselness response. minVesselLength/odRadiusRange/foveaSearchWindow are px at 512 (disc-scaled where noted in code). odSearchTopPercent = brightest fraction of inpainted image searched for the OD. foveaDiscDiameters = temporal offset of the fovea from the OD in disc DIAMETERS. odFallbackRadiusFraction = OD radius as a fraction of FOV radius when localisation fails.

sim._comment: Track C (Capacity model). DEFAULT district-programme parameters mirroring the 15 masked Simulink parameters, plus solver settings. These are SIMULATION inputs, not clinical measurements. inferenceSecPerImage and reviewSecPerCase are seeded here as documented ASSUMPTIONS; netra.sim.buildParams overrides them from measured latency (timing.log) and audit data (auditStats) when available, and the UI labels each parameter measured vs assumed. autoClearRate default 0 = every case reviewed (baseline); the app derives the enabled value from the routing split.
